title: Prescriptions Store Rule: Count Hold on Declined Controlled Balances
content:
When a patient declines the owed balance of a Kestrel Prescriptions record in the Schedule V Controlled Prescription, Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription or Schedule II Controlled Prescription class, the store keeps a controlled count hold that depends on how long the balance has stood.

## Rule

The controlled count hold counts the calendar days from the controlled short fill's dispensing date, as day 0, to today:

| Days from the dispensing date to today | Count hold kept |
|---|---|
| 7 or more | 1.50 |
| 1 up to fewer than 7 | 0.75 |
| 0 (declined on the dispensing date) | nothing |

The count hold is taken off the controlled unpaid value, and the unpaid value after what is kept is never below zero.

## Both sides (hypothetical short fill dispensed on day 0)

- Declined on day 6: 0.75 kept. Declined on day 7: 1.50 kept.
- Declined on day 0: nothing kept. Declined on day 1: 0.75 kept.
- An unpaid value of 1.00 declined on day 9 keeps 1.50; never below zero, so 0.00 remains.
